doc.reasoning: R-TASK-040 requires that GET /openapi.json documents TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas. Tests must verify: (1) positive — all three schema names appear in the OpenAPI spec components; (2) negative — the endpoint returns a valid JSON document (not 4xx/5xx), ruling out misconfiguration; (3) boundary — each schema contains the exact fields defined in schemas.py (title, description, completed for TaskCreate/TaskUpdate; id, created_at, updated_at for Task). Mutation-resilient assertions use exact string keys, exact HTTP status code 200, and exact field membership checks to catch constant-mutation, key-rename, and boolean-negation operators.

tests.name: test_openapi_contains_all_three_task_schemas
preconditions: GET /openapi.json is served by the app
actions: Check that 'TaskCreate', 'TaskUpdate', and 'Task' all appear in components/schemas
trace: R-TASK-040: system shall document TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas in the OpenAPI spec
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_openapi_contains_all_three_task_schemas():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    schemas = body["components"]["schemas"]
    assert "TaskCreate" in schemas
    assert "TaskUpdate" in schemas
    assert "Task" in schemas

test_openapi_contains_all_three_task_schemas()

preconditions: All three task schemas must be present simultaneously
actions: Collect all schema names from components/schemas
Assert that the set {'TaskCreate', 'TaskUpdate', 'Task'} is a subset of the schema names
Assert the count of task-related schemas is exactly 3 (no partial documentation)
expected: Exactly TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task are all present
No task schema is missing from the spec
trace: R-TASK-040: system shall document TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, AND Task — all three required simultaneously
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_openapi_schema_count_not_missing_any_task_schema():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    schema_names = set(body["components"]["schemas"].keys())
    required_schemas = {"TaskCreate", "TaskUpdate", "Task"}
    missing = required_schemas - schema_names
    assert missing == set(), f"Missing schemas: {missing}"
    task_schemas_present = required_schemas & schema_names
    assert len(task_schemas_present) == 3

test_openapi_schema_count_not_missing_any_task_schema()
